description: This file defines a React component for optimized image rendering in Next.js, including static image handling, various loaders, and responsive image sizing.

classes.name: StaticImageData
classes.description: Interface representing static image data including src, height, width, and optional blurDataURL.

classes.name: StaticRequire
classes.description: Interface for static require objects containing StaticImageData.

methods.name: isStaticRequire
methods.description: Type guard to check if src is a StaticRequire object.

methods.name: isStaticImageData
methods.description: Type guard to check if src is StaticImageData.

methods.name: isStaticImport
methods.description: Type guard to check if src is a StaticImport (either StaticRequire or StaticImageData).

methods.name: generateImgAttrs
methods.description: Generates src, srcSet, and sizes attributes for the image based on layout and loader.

methods.name: defaultImageLoader
methods.description: Default loader function that constructs image URLs based on configuration.

methods.name: removePlaceholder
methods.description: Removes blur placeholder styles once the image loads.

methods.name: Image
methods.description: Main React component for optimized image rendering with support for static images, lazy loading, and responsive layouts.

methods.name: normalizeSrc
methods.description: Normalizes source URL by removing leading slash.

methods.name: imgixLoader
methods.description: Constructs image URL for Imgix CDN.

methods.name: akamaiLoader
methods.description: Constructs image URL for Akamai CDN.

methods.name: cloudinaryLoader
methods.description: Constructs image URL for Cloudinary CDN.

methods.name: defaultLoader
methods.description: Constructs default image URL with encoded source and parameters.
